name: Advance Elementor Slider
author: Pratap Dungrani

sections.description:
Adds six widgets under an “Advance Slider” category in the Elementor panel:

  1. Advance Slider – full-bleed hero slides with background image, subtitle, title, description and two buttons per slide. Ken Burns zoom and staggered copy animation.
  2. Post Slider – a carousel of posts from any post type, filtered by term, with featured image, meta, excerpt and a read-more button.
  3. Testimonial Slider – quote cards with star rating, photo, name and role.
  4. Logo Carousel – client or partner logos with optional links, grayscale-until-hover and captions.
  5. Thumbnail Slider – a gallery whose main image is synced to a clickable thumbnail strip.
  6. Team Slider – team member cards with photo, role, short bio and social links.

All six share one behaviour layer: transition effect, responsive slides-per-view and spacing, autoplay with pause-on-hover, loop, free mode, keyboard and mousewheel input, arrows with custom icons, and dots / fraction / progress-bar pagination.

Responsive settings are mapped onto Elementor’s own breakpoints, so custom breakpoints keep working.

The widgets reuse the Swiper 8 library that ships with Elementor, so the page never loads a second copy of Swiper.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the advance-elementor-slider folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor and look for the “Advance Slider” category in the widget panel.

short_description: Six Swiper-powered slider and carousel widgets for Elementor, sharing one base class and one asset pair.
